+import backtrader as bt
+
+
+class BreakoutAfterDoubleBottom(bt.Strategy):
+    params = (
+        ("support", 135.0),
+        ("bottom_tolerance", 0.1),
+        ("resistance", 191.8),
+        ("volume_period", 20),
+        ("volume_multiplier", 1.2),
+        ("stop_price", 132.3),
+        ("risk_fraction", 0.015),
+        ("consolidation_low", 134.2),
+        ("consolidation_period", 20),
+    )
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.volume_average = bt.indicators.SimpleMovingAverage(
+            self.data.volume, period=self.p.volume_period
+        )
+        self.order = None
+        self.stop_order = None
+        self.take_profit_order = None
+        self.exit_requested = False
+        self.bar_history = []
+        self.first_bottom = False
+        self.first_bottom_low = None
+        self.intervening_local_high = False
+        self.pattern_formed = False
+        self.pattern_low = None
+
+    def _in_bottom_zone(self, value):
+        return self.p.support - self.p.bottom_tolerance <= value <= (
+            self.p.support + self.p.bottom_tolerance
+        )
+
+    def _record_pattern(self):
+        if len(self.bar_history) < self.p.consolidation_period + 2:
+            return
+
+        previous = self.bar_history[-2]
+        previous_low = previous[1]
+        is_local_low = (
+            previous_low <= self.bar_history[-3][1]
+            and previous_low <= self.bar_history[-1][1]
+        )
+        is_local_high = (
+            previous[0] >= self.bar_history[-3][0]
+            and previous[0] >= self.bar_history[-1][0]
+        )
+
+        if self.first_bottom and is_local_high:
+            self.intervening_local_high = True
+
+        if not (is_local_low and self._in_bottom_zone(previous_low)):
+            return
+
+        if self.first_bottom and self.intervening_local_high:
+            self.pattern_formed = True
+            self.pattern_low = min(self.first_bottom_low, previous_low)
+            return
+
+        preceding_bars = self.bar_history[
+            -(self.p.consolidation_period + 2) : -2
+        ]
+        consolidated = all(
+            bar_low >= self.p.consolidation_low
+            and bar_high <= self.p.resistance
+            for bar_high, bar_low in preceding_bars
+        )
+        if consolidated:
+            self.first_bottom = True
+            self.first_bottom_low = previous_low
+            self.intervening_local_high = False
+
+    def _submit_protective_orders(self, size):
+        pattern_height = self.p.resistance - self.pattern_low
+        take_profit = self.p.resistance + pattern_height
+        self.stop_order = self.sell(
+            size=size, exectype=bt.Order.Stop, price=self.p.stop_price
+        )
+        self.take_profit_order = self.sell(
+            size=size,
+            exectype=bt.Order.Limit,
+            price=take_profit,
+            oco=self.stop_order,
+        )
+
+    def _protective_orders_finished(self):
+        return self.stop_order is None and self.take_profit_order is None
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        if order.status not in (
+            order.Completed,
+            order.Canceled,
+            order.Margin,
+            order.Rejected,
+        ):
+            return
+
+        if order is self.order:
+            self.order = None
+            if order.status == order.Completed and order.isbuy():
+                self._submit_protective_orders(order.executed.size)
+        elif order is self.stop_order:
+            self.stop_order = None
+        elif order is self.take_profit_order:
+            self.take_profit_order = None
+
+        if (
+            self.exit_requested
+            and self.position
+            and self.order is None
+            and self._protective_orders_finished()
+        ):
+            self.exit_requested = False
+            self.order = self.close()
+
+    def next(self):
+        self.bar_history.append((self.data.high[0], self.data.low[0]))
+        self._record_pattern()
+
+        if self.position:
+            if self.data.close[0] < self.p.support and not self.exit_requested:
+                self.exit_requested = True
+                if self.stop_order is not None:
+                    self.cancel(self.stop_order)
+                if self.take_profit_order is not None:
+                    self.cancel(self.take_profit_order)
+                if self._protective_orders_finished() and self.order is None:
+                    self.exit_requested = False
+                    self.order = self.close()
+            return
+
+        if self.order is not None or not self._protective_orders_finished():
+            return
+
+        after_october_2023 = self.data.datetime.date(0).isoformat() >= "2023-11-01"
+        breakout = (
+            self.data.close[-1] <= self.p.resistance
+            and self.data.close[0] > self.p.resistance
+        )
+        volume_confirmed = self.data.volume[0] >= (
+            self.p.volume_multiplier * self.volume_average[0]
+        )
+        if self.pattern_formed and after_october_2023 and breakout and volume_confirmed:
+            risk_capital = self.broker.getvalue() * self.p.risk_fraction
+            risk_per_share = self.data.close[0] - self.p.stop_price
+            if risk_per_share > 0:
+                size = int(risk_capital / risk_per_share)
+                if size > 0:
+                    self.order = self.buy(size=size)

+import backtrader as bt

+class QBTSRangeVolumeBreakout(bt.Strategy):
+    params = (
+        ("range_period", 20),
+        ("volume_period", 20),
+        ("volume_multiplier", 2.15),
+        ("target_price", 28.00),
+    )
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.previous_range_high = bt.indicators.Highest(
+            self.data.high(-1), period=self.p.range_period
+        )
+        self.average_volume = bt.indicators.SimpleMovingAverage(
+            self.data.volume, period=self.p.volume_period
+        )
+        self.order = None
+
+    def next(self):
+        if self.order:
+            return
+
+        if self.position:
+            if self.data.high[0] >= self.p.target_price:
+                self.order = self.close()
+            else:
+                # With one daily bar per session, processing this bar is the
+                # closest available representation of the end of that day.
+                self.order = self.close()
+            return
+
+        range_breakout = self.data.open[0] > self.previous_range_high[0]
+        volume_breakout = (
+            self.data.volume[0]
+            > self.p.volume_multiplier * self.average_volume[0]
+        )
+        if range_breakout and volume_breakout:
+            self.order = self.order_target_percent(target=1.0)

+        if order.status in (
+            order.Completed,
+            order.Canceled,
+            order.Margin,
+            order.Rejected,

+import backtrader as bt
+
+
+class RegimeBasedVolatilityStrategy(bt.Strategy):
+    params = (
+        ("base_risk_percent", 0.01),
+    )
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.atr = bt.indicators.ATR(self.data, period=14)
+        self.bbands = bt.indicators.BollingerBands(
+            self.data.close, period=20, devfactor=2
+        )
+        self.bb_width = self.bbands.top - self.bbands.bot
+        self.atr_ema = bt.indicators.EMA(self.atr, period=50)
+        self.bb_width_ema = bt.indicators.EMA(self.bb_width, period=50)
+        self.cvi = 0.5 * (self.atr / self.atr_ema) + 0.5 * (
+            self.bb_width / self.bb_width_ema
+        )
+
+        self.ema10 = bt.indicators.EMA(self.data.close, period=10)
+        self.ema30 = bt.indicators.EMA(self.data.close, period=30)
+        self.sma50 = bt.indicators.SMA(self.data.close, period=50)
+        self.rsi = bt.indicators.RSI(self.data.close, period=14)
+        self.macd = bt.indicators.MACDHisto(
+            self.data.close,
+            period_me1=12,
+            period_me2=26,
+            period_signal=9,
+        )
+
+        self.ema_cross = bt.indicators.CrossOver(self.ema10, self.ema30)
+        self.cvi_cross = bt.indicators.CrossOver(self.cvi, 1.0)
+        self.macd_hist_cross = bt.indicators.CrossOver(self.macd.histo, 0.0)
+        self.rsi_50_cross = bt.indicators.CrossOver(self.rsi, 50.0)
+
+        # PC3 proxy is deliberately observed but is not used by any signal.
+        self.j = self.atr / self.bb_width
+
+        self.order = None
+        self.pending_trade_type = None
+        self.trade_type = None
+        self.entry_price = None
+        self.stop_distance = None
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        if order.status == order.Completed:
+            if order.isbuy() and self.position.size > 0:
+                self.trade_type = self.pending_trade_type
+                self.entry_price = order.executed.price
+                multiplier = 1.5 if self.trade_type == "low" else 2.5
+                self.stop_distance = multiplier * self.atr[0]
+            elif order.issell() and self.position.size < 0:
+                self.trade_type = self.pending_trade_type
+                self.entry_price = order.executed.price
+                multiplier = 1.5 if self.trade_type == "low" else 2.5
+                self.stop_distance = multiplier * self.atr[0]
+            elif not self.position:
+                self.trade_type = None
+                self.entry_price = None
+                self.stop_distance = None
+
+        if order.status in (
+            order.Completed,
+            order.Canceled,
+            order.Margin,
+            order.Rejected,
+        ):
+            self.order = None
+            self.pending_trade_type = None
+
+    def _size_for_entry(self, trade_type):
+        cvi = self.cvi[0]
+        if cvi < 0.9:
+            size_multiplier = 1.3
+        elif cvi > 1.1:
+            size_multiplier = 0.7
+        else:
+            size_multiplier = 1.0
+
+        atr_multiplier = 1.5 if trade_type == "low" else 2.5
+        risk_per_share = atr_multiplier * self.atr[0]
+        base_size = (self.broker.getvalue() * self.p.base_risk_percent) / risk_per_share
+        return max(1, int(base_size * size_multiplier))
+
+    def _enter(self, direction, trade_type):
+        self.pending_trade_type = trade_type
+        size = self._size_for_entry(trade_type)
+        if direction > 0:
+            self.order = self.buy(size=size)
+        else:
+            self.order = self.sell(size=size)
+
+    def next(self):
+        if self.order:
+            return
+
+        if self.position:
+            is_long = self.position.size > 0
+            regime_exit = (
+                self.trade_type == "high" and self.cvi_cross[0] < 0
+            ) or (self.trade_type == "low" and self.cvi_cross[0] > 0)
+
+            atr_stop = False
+            if self.entry_price is not None and self.stop_distance is not None:
+                if is_long:
+                    atr_stop = self.data.close[0] <= self.entry_price - self.stop_distance
+                else:
+                    atr_stop = self.data.close[0] >= self.entry_price + self.stop_distance
+
+            mean_reversion_exit = self.trade_type == "high" and (
+                (is_long and (self.data.close[0] >= self.bbands.mid[0] or self.rsi[0] > 55))
+                or (
+                    not is_long
+                    and (self.data.close[0] <= self.bbands.mid[0] or self.rsi[0] < 45)
+                )
+            )
+
+            # Each input bar is one complete trading day, so every open position
+            # is submitted for closure after processing that day's bar.
+            end_of_trading_day = True
+            if regime_exit or atr_stop or mean_reversion_exit or end_of_trading_day:
+                self.order = self.close()
+            return
+
+        low_long = (
+            self.cvi[0] < 0.9
+            and self.ema_cross[0] > 0
+            and self.data.close[0] > self.sma50[0]
+            and self.rsi[0] > 50
+        )
+        low_short = (
+            self.cvi[0] < 0.9
+            and self.ema_cross[0] < 0
+            and self.data.close[0] < self.sma50[0]
+            and self.rsi[0] < 50
+        )
+        high_long = (
+            self.cvi[0] > 1.1
+            and self.data.low[0] <= self.bbands.bot[0]
+            and self.rsi[0] < 35
+        )
+        high_short = (
+            self.cvi[0] > 1.1
+            and self.data.high[0] >= self.bbands.top[0]
+            and self.rsi[0] > 65
+        )
+        shift_long = (
+            self.cvi_cross[0] > 0
+            and self.macd_hist_cross[0] > 0
+            and self.rsi_50_cross[0] > 0
+            and self.rsi[0] > 50
+            and self.data.close[0] > self.sma50[0]
+        )
+        shift_short = (
+            self.cvi_cross[0] < 0
+            and self.macd_hist_cross[0] < 0
+            and self.rsi_50_cross[0] < 0
+            and self.rsi[0] < 50
+            and self.data.close[0] < self.sma50[0]
+        )
+
+        if low_long:
+            self._enter(1, "low")
+        elif low_short:
+            self._enter(-1, "low")
+        elif high_long:
+            self._enter(1, "high")
+        elif high_short:
+            self._enter(-1, "high")
+        elif shift_long:
+            self._enter(1, "high")
+        elif shift_short:
+            self._enter(-1, "low")

+import backtrader as bt
+
+
+class PeriodicTargetWeightStrategy(bt.Strategy):
+    params = (
+        ("target_weights", ()),
+        ("rebalancing_period", "quarterly"),
+    )
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        if self.p.rebalancing_period not in ("quarterly", "yearly"):
+            raise ValueError("rebalancing_period must be 'quarterly' or 'yearly'")
+
+        self.order = None
+        self._weight_index = 0
+        self._last_rebalance_period = None
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.broker.setcommission(commission=0.001)
+        self.broker.set_slippage_perc(perc=0.0005, slip_open=True)
+
+    def _period(self, date):
+        if self.p.rebalancing_period == "yearly":
+            return date.year
+        return date.year, (date.month - 1) // 3 + 1
+
+    def next(self):
+        date = self.data.datetime.date(0)
+        period = self._period(date)
+
+        if period == self._last_rebalance_period:
+            return
+
+        self._last_rebalance_period = period
+        if self.order is not None or self._weight_index >= len(self.p.target_weights):
+            return
+
+        weight = self.p.target_weights[self._weight_index]
+        self._weight_index += 1
+        if not 0 <= weight <= 1:
+            raise ValueError("target weights must be in the range [0, 1]")
+
+        if weight == 0:
+            if self.position:
+                self.order = self.close()
+            return
+
+        price = self.data.close[0]
+        target_shares = int((weight * self.broker.getvalue()) / price)
+        self.order = self.order_target_size(target=target_shares)
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        if order.status in (
+            order.Completed,
+            order.Canceled,
+            order.Margin,
+            order.Rejected,
+        ):
+            self.order = None

+import backtrader as bt
+
+
+class AAPLReversalStrategy(bt.Strategy):
+    params = (
+        ("sma_period", 20),
+        ("slope_lag", 20),
+        ("std_lookback", 100),
+        ("extreme_mult", 2.0),
+        ("stop_pct", 0.02),
+        ("neutral_mult", 0.2),
+    )
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.sma20 = bt.indicators.SMA(
+            self.data.close, period=self.p.sma_period
+        )
+        self.slope = (
+            self.sma20 - self.sma20(-self.p.slope_lag)
+        ) / self.p.slope_lag
+        self.slope_std = bt.indicators.StdDev(
+            self.slope, period=self.p.std_lookback
+        )
+
+        self.pos_th = self.p.extreme_mult * self.slope_std
+        self.neg_th = -self.p.extreme_mult * self.slope_std
+        self.neutral_band = self.p.neutral_mult * self.slope_std
+
+        self.entry_order = None
+        self.exit_order = None
+        self.stop_order = None
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        terminal = (
+            order.Completed,
+            order.Canceled,
+            order.Margin,
+            order.Rejected,
+        )
+        if order.status not in terminal:
+            return
+
+        if order is self.entry_order:
+            self.entry_order = None
+            if order.status == order.Completed:
+                entry_price = order.executed.price
+                if order.isbuy():
+                    stop_price = entry_price * (1.0 - self.p.stop_pct)
+                    self.stop_order = self.sell(
+                        size=order.executed.size,
+                        exectype=bt.Order.Stop,
+                        price=stop_price,
+                    )
+                else:
+                    stop_price = entry_price * (1.0 + self.p.stop_pct)
+                    self.stop_order = self.buy(
+                        size=abs(order.executed.size),
+                        exectype=bt.Order.Stop,
+                        price=stop_price,
+                    )
+        elif order is self.exit_order:
+            self.exit_order = None
+        elif order is self.stop_order:
+            self.stop_order = None
+
+    def next(self):
+        if self.entry_order is not None or self.exit_order is not None:
+            return
+
+        if self.position:
+            crossed_zero = (
+                (self.slope[-1] <= 0.0 and self.slope[0] > 0.0)
+                or (self.slope[-1] >= 0.0 and self.slope[0] < 0.0)
+            )
+            inside_neutral_band = (
+                abs(self.slope[0]) < self.neutral_band[0]
+            )
+            if crossed_zero or inside_neutral_band:
+                if self.stop_order is not None:
+                    self.cancel(self.stop_order)
+                self.exit_order = self.close()
+            return
+
+        long_reversal = (
+            self.slope[-1] <= self.neg_th[-1]
+            and self.slope[0] > self.neg_th[0]
+        )
+        short_reversal = (
+            self.slope[-1] >= self.pos_th[-1]
+            and self.slope[0] < self.pos_th[0]
+        )
+
+        if long_reversal:
+            self.entry_order = self.buy()
+        elif short_reversal:
+            self.entry_order = self.sell()

+import backtrader as bt
+
+
+class BollingerBandwidthReversal(bt.Strategy):
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.order = None
+        self.stop_order = None
+
+        self.bollinger = bt.indicators.BollingerBands(
+            self.data.close, period=20, devfactor=2
+        )
+        self.bandwidth = (
+            (self.bollinger.top - self.bollinger.bot) / self.bollinger.mid
+        )
+        self.bw_sma = bt.indicators.SMA(self.bandwidth, period=20)
+        self.bw_std = bt.indicators.StdDev(self.bandwidth, period=20)
+        self.bw_z = (self.bandwidth - self.bw_sma) / self.bw_std
+        self.atr = bt.indicators.ATR(self.data, period=14)
+
+    def next(self):
+        if self.order:
+            return
+
+        zero_cross = (
+            (self.bw_z[-1] > 0 and self.bw_z[0] <= 0)
+            or (self.bw_z[-1] < 0 and self.bw_z[0] >= 0)
+        )
+        mean_reverted = zero_cross or abs(self.bw_z[0]) < 0.5
+
+        if self.position:
+            if mean_reverted:
+                if self.stop_order:
+                    self.cancel(self.stop_order)
+                    self.stop_order = None
+                self.order = self.close()
+            return
+
+        long_reversal = (
+            self.bw_z[-1] > 2
+            and self.bw_z[0] <= 2
+            and self.bandwidth[0] < self.bandwidth[-1]
+        )
+        short_reversal = (
+            self.bw_z[-1] < -2
+            and self.bw_z[0] >= -2
+            and self.bandwidth[0] > self.bandwidth[-1]
+        )
+
+        if long_reversal:
+            self.order = self.buy()
+        elif short_reversal:
+            self.order = self.sell()
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        if order.status == order.Completed:
+            if order is self.order:
+                self.order = None
+                if self.position.size > 0:
+                    stop_price = order.executed.price - 2 * self.atr[0]
+                    self.stop_order = self.sell(
+                        exectype=bt.Order.Stop, price=stop_price
+                    )
+                elif self.position.size < 0:
+                    stop_price = order.executed.price + 2 * self.atr[0]
+                    self.stop_order = self.buy(
+                        exectype=bt.Order.Stop, price=stop_price
+                    )
+            elif order is self.stop_order:
+                self.stop_order = None
+        elif order.status in [
+            order.Canceled,
+            order.Margin,
+            order.Rejected,
+        ]:
+            if order is self.order:
+                self.order = None
+            elif order is self.stop_order:
+                self.stop_order = None

+import backtrader as bt

+class ROCBasedTechnicalStrategy(bt.Strategy):
+    params = (
+        ("fast_period", 20),
+        ("slow_period", 50),
+    )

+import backtrader as bt
+
+
+class MonthlySeasonalityStrategy(bt.Strategy):
+    """Trade the average return of prior occurrences of each calendar month."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.order = None
+        self.entry_price = None
+        self.current_month = None
+        self.month_first_open = None
+        self.month_last_close = None
+        self.month_is_complete = False
+        self.monthly_returns = {month: [] for month in range(1, 13)}
+        self.month_bias = 0
+        self.stopped_this_month = False
+        self.entry_after_close = 0
+
+    def _submit_entry(self, bias):
+        if bias > 0:
+            self.order = self.buy()
+        elif bias < 0:
+            self.order = self.sell()
+
+    def _apply_monthly_target(self):
+        if self.order is not None:
+            return
+
+        position_bias = 1 if self.position.size > 0 else -1 if self.position.size < 0 else 0
+        if position_bias == self.month_bias:
+            return
+
+        if position_bias:
+            self.entry_after_close = self.month_bias
+            self.order = self.close()
+        else:
+            self._submit_entry(self.month_bias)
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        if order.status in (order.Submitted, order.Accepted):
+            return
+
+        completed = order.status == order.Completed
+        if completed:
+            if order.isbuy() and self.position.size > 0:
+                self.entry_price = order.executed.price
+            elif order.issell() and self.position.size < 0:
+                self.entry_price = order.executed.price
+            elif not self.position:
+                self.entry_price = None
+
+        if order.status in (order.Completed, order.Canceled, order.Margin, order.Rejected):
+            self.order = None
+            if completed and not self.position and self.entry_after_close and not self.stopped_this_month:
+                bias = self.entry_after_close
+                self.entry_after_close = 0
+                self._submit_entry(bias)
+            elif not self.position:
+                self.entry_after_close = 0
+
+    def next(self):
+        bar_date = self.data.datetime.date(0)
+        bar_month = (bar_date.year, bar_date.month)
+
+        if self.current_month is None:
+            self.current_month = bar_month
+            self.month_first_open = float(self.data.open[0])
+            self.month_last_close = float(self.data.close[0])
+            # The fixed feed begins late in May, so its first month does not
+            # contain the actual first open and cannot define a monthly return.
+            self.month_is_complete = bar_date.day <= 3
+            prior = self.monthly_returns[bar_date.month]
+            self.month_bias = 0 if not prior else (1 if sum(prior) / len(prior) > 0 else -1 if sum(prior) / len(prior) < 0 else 0)
+            self._apply_monthly_target()
+            return
+
+        if bar_month != self.current_month:
+            if self.month_is_complete:
+                completed_return = self.month_last_close / self.month_first_open - 1.0
+                self.monthly_returns[self.current_month[1]].append(completed_return)
+
+            self.current_month = bar_month
+            self.month_first_open = float(self.data.open[0])
+            self.month_last_close = float(self.data.close[0])
+            self.month_is_complete = True
+            self.stopped_this_month = False
+            self.entry_after_close = 0
+
+            prior = self.monthly_returns[bar_date.month]
+            average = sum(prior) / len(prior) if prior else 0.0
+            self.month_bias = 1 if average > 0 else -1 if average < 0 else 0
+            self._apply_monthly_target()
+            return
+
+        self.month_last_close = float(self.data.close[0])
+
+        if self.order is None and self.position and self.entry_price is not None:
+            stop_hit = (
+                self.position.size > 0 and self.data.low[0] <= self.entry_price * 0.98
+            ) or (
+                self.position.size < 0 and self.data.high[0] >= self.entry_price * 1.02
+            )
+            if stop_hit:
+                self.stopped_this_month = True
+                self.entry_after_close = 0
+                self.order = self.close()

+

+        sentiment_sma20 = self.sentiment_sma20[0]
+        long_signal = (
+            self.cross_upper[0] > 0 and sentiment > sentiment_sma20
+        )
+        short_signal = (
+            self.cross_lower[0] < 0 and sentiment < sentiment_sma20
+        )
+        return long_signal, short_signal
+

+        sentiment = self.sentiment[0]
+        sentiment_sma20 = self.sentiment_sma20[0]
+        size_multiplier = 1 + self.p.sentiment_multiplier * abs(

+        )
+        return self.p.base_size * size_multiplier

+        self.order = None

+        atr = self.atr[0]

+                close >= self.entry_price * 1.20
+                or close <= self.entry_price * 0.90
+                or self.cross[0] < 0
+                or self.rsi[0] >= 70
+                or close >= self.bollinger.top[0]
+                or atr / close > 0.06

+                self.order = self.close()

+            else math.nan

+        risk_budget = self.broker.getvalue() * self.p.risk_fraction
+        atr_risk_size = int(risk_budget / atr)
+        affordable_size = int(self.broker.getcash() / self.data.close[0])

+        )

+        )

+        self.strike_plus_two_sigma = self.ema + 2.0 * self.standard_deviation

+        self.stop_order = None

+        self.entry_bar = None
+        self.peak_value = self.broker.getvalue()
+        self.trading_stopped = False

+                order.Canceled,
+                order.Margin,

+                if order.status == order.Completed:

+            return

+                self.stop_order = self.sell(

+import backtrader as bt

+
+class OptionProxyStrategy(bt.Strategy):
+    """Selectable reference implementation of the CSP and CC proxy rules."""
+
+    params = (('strategy', 'csp'),)
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.atr = bt.indicators.ATR(self.data, period=14)
+        self.bollinger = bt.indicators.BollingerBands(
+            self.data.close, period=20, devfactor=2
+        )
+        self.sma = bt.indicators.SMA(self.data.close, period=50)
+        self.ema = bt.indicators.EMA(self.data.close, period=20)
+        self.rsi = bt.indicators.RSI(self.data.close, period=14)
+        self.volume_sma = bt.indicators.SMA(self.data.volume, period=20)
+        self.crossover = bt.indicators.CrossOver(self.ema, self.sma)
+
+        self.order = None
+        self.entry_price = None
+        self.entry_bar = None
+        self.entry_k = None
+        self.protection_active = False
+
+    def _k(self):
+        return min(max(self.atr[0] / self.data.close[0], 0.01), 0.05)
+
+    def _size(self, price, fraction):
+        # Include the fixed harness commission so the requested allocation is
+        # not rejected for requiring more cash than the broker holds.
+        capital = self.broker.getvalue() * fraction
+        return capital / (price * 1.001)
+
+    def next(self):
+        if self.order:
+            return
+
+        if not self.position:
+            if self.p.strategy == 'csp':
+                self._enter_csp()
+            elif self.p.strategy == 'cc':
+                self._enter_cc()
+            else:
+                raise ValueError("strategy must be 'csp' or 'cc'")
+            return
+
+        if self.p.strategy == 'csp':
+            self._exit_csp()
+        else:
+            self._exit_cc()
+
+    def _enter_csp(self):
+        k = self._k()
+        limit_price = self.data.close[0] * (1.0 - k)
+        liquid = self.data.volume[0] > self.volume_sma[0]
+        if (self.data.close[0] < self.bollinger.bot[0]
+                and self.rsi[0] < 35
+                and liquid):
+            self.order = self.buy(
+                exectype=bt.Order.Limit,
+                price=limit_price,
+                size=self._size(limit_price, 0.20),
+            )
+
+    def _enter_cc(self):
+        liquid = self.data.volume[0] > self.volume_sma[0]
+        if self.crossover[0] > 0 and self.data.close[0] > self.ema[0] and liquid:
+            self.order = self.buy(size=self._size(self.data.close[0], 1.0))
+
+    def _exit_csp(self):
+        fixed_profit = self.entry_price + 0.5 * self.entry_k * self.entry_price
+        profit_target = max(fixed_profit, self.bollinger.mid[0])
+        take_profit = self.data.high[0] >= profit_target
+        stop_loss = self.data.low[0] <= self.entry_price - 1.5 * self.atr[0]
+        timed_out = len(self) - self.entry_bar >= 20
+        if take_profit or stop_loss or timed_out:
+            self.order = self.close()
+
+    def _exit_cc(self):
+        full_profit = self.entry_price + self.entry_k * self.entry_price
+        protection_level = self.entry_price + 0.5 * self.entry_k * self.entry_price
+
+        take_profit = (self.data.high[0] >= self.bollinger.top[0]
+                       or self.data.high[0] >= full_profit)
+        if self.data.high[0] >= protection_level:
+            self.protection_active = True
+
+        protected_exit = self.protection_active and self.data.close[0] < self.ema[0]
+        stop_loss = self.data.close[0] < self.ema[0] - self.atr[0]
+        reverse_cross = self.crossover[0] < 0
+        timed_out = len(self) - self.entry_bar >= 20
+
+        if take_profit or protected_exit or stop_loss or reverse_cross or timed_out:
+            self.order = self.close()
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        if order.status == order.Completed:
+            if order.isbuy():
+                self.entry_price = order.executed.price
+                self.entry_bar = len(self)
+                self.entry_k = self._k()
+                self.protection_active = False
+            else:
+                self.entry_price = None
+                self.entry_bar = None
+                self.entry_k = None
+                self.protection_active = False
+
+        if order.status in (order.Completed, order.Canceled,
+                            order.Margin, order.Rejected):
+            self.order = None

+        range_timeout=5,
+    )

+        self.atr = bt.indicators.ATR(self.data, period=14)
+        self.ema = bt.indicators.EMA(self.data.close, period=20)
+        self.rsi = bt.indicators.RSI(self.data.close, period=14)
+        self.volume_sma = bt.indicators.SMA(self.data.volume, period=20)
+        self.crossover = bt.indicators.CrossOver(self.data.close, self.ema)
+        self.addminperiod(self.p.percentile_period)
+
+        self.logs = []
+        self._orders = {}
+        self._state = {1: None, 2: None, 3: None}
+        self._pending = {1: None, 2: None, 3: None}
+        self._session = None
+        self._session_bars = 0
+        self._or_high = None
+        self._or_low = None
+        self._or_ready = False
+
+    def _bandwidth(self, ago=0):
+        middle = self.bbands.mid[ago]
+        return (self.bbands.top[ago] - self.bbands.bot[ago]) / middle
+
+    def _bw_percentile(self):
+        current = self._bandwidth()
+        values = [self._bandwidth(-i) for i in range(self.p.percentile_period)]
+        return 100.0 * sum(value <= current for value in values) / len(values)
+
+    def _size(self, strategy, stop_distance):
+        if stop_distance <= 0 or not math.isfinite(stop_distance):
+            return 0
+        risk_size = math.floor((self.p.base_capital * self.p.risk_per_trade) / stop_distance)
+        allocation = {1: 0.40, 2: 0.30, 3: 0.30}[strategy] * self.p.base_capital
+        allocation_size = math.floor(allocation / self.data.close[0])
+        return max(0, min(risk_size, allocation_size))

+        record = {
+            'datetime': self.data.datetime.datetime(0).isoformat(),
+            'event': event,

+
+    def notify_order(self, order):

+                if state['direction'] == 1:
+                    state['stop'] = max(atr_stop, opposite_or)

+                    state['stop'] = min(atr_stop, opposite_or)
+                state['risk'] = abs(state['entry'] - state['stop'])
+                state['target'] = (state['entry'] + 2 * state['risk']

+            elif strategy == 1:

+                          else state['entry'] - 0.5 * state['risk'])

+                                   if state['direction'] == 1
+                                   else max(state['target'], half_r))
+            self._log('entry', strategy, price=state['entry'], size=state['size'],
+                      bandwidth_percentile=state['bw_percentile'])
+        else:
+            reason = information[2]
+            pnl_per_share = state['direction'] * (order.executed.price - state['entry'])
+            r_multiple = pnl_per_share / state['risk'] if state['risk'] else 0.0
+            self._log('exit', strategy, price=order.executed.price, reason=reason,

+                      bandwidth_percentile=state['bw_percentile'])
+            self._state[strategy] = None
+
+    def _update_opening_range(self):
+        session = self.data.datetime.date(0)

+            self._or_low = None

+            elif direction == -1 and self.data.high[0] >= state['stop']:

+                    state['stop'] = min(state['stop'], trail)
+                if eod:

+            elif strategy == 2 and eod:

+            elif strategy == 1 and state['bars'] >= self.p.range_timeout:
+                self._exit(strategy, 'timeout')

+    def prenext(self):

+        )
+        self.atr14 = bt.indicators.AverageTrueRange(self.data, period=14)
+
+        self.order = None
+        self.pending_add_on = False
+        self.added_once = False
+        self.highest_close_since_entry = None
+        self.initial_stop = None
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        if order.status == order.Completed:
+            if order.isbuy():
+                first_entry = self.highest_close_since_entry is None
+                if first_entry:
+                    self.highest_close_since_entry = float(self.data.close[0])
+                else:
+                    self.highest_close_since_entry = max(
+                        self.highest_close_since_entry, float(self.data.close[0])
+                    )
+
+                if first_entry:
+                    entry_price = float(order.executed.price)
+                    self.initial_stop = entry_price - max(
+                        0.08 * entry_price, 2.0 * float(self.atr14[0])
+                    )
+                if self.pending_add_on:
+                    self.added_once = True
+            elif not self.position:
+                self.added_once = False
+                self.highest_close_since_entry = None
+                self.initial_stop = None
+
+        if order.status in (
+            order.Completed,
+            order.Canceled,
+            order.Margin,
+            order.Rejected,
+        ):
+            self.order = None
+            self.pending_add_on = False
+
+    def _size_for_allocation(self, allocation, maximum_allocation=None):
+        capital = float(self.broker.getvalue())
+        price = float(self.data.close[0])
+        shares = math.floor((allocation * capital) / price)
+
+        if maximum_allocation is not None:
+            maximum_shares = math.floor((maximum_allocation * capital) / price)
+            shares = min(shares, max(0, maximum_shares - self.position.size))
+
+        return max(0, shares)
+
+    def next(self):
+        if self.order:
+            return
+
+        close = float(self.data.close[0])
+
+        if not self.position:
+            trend_filter = close > float(self.sma200[0])
+            momentum_entry = self.ema_cross[0] > 0 or self.rsi_cross_50[0] > 0
+            volume_confirmed = (

+

+        trailing_stop = max(

+
+        if take_profit or stop_hit or trend_reversal:

+            size = self._size_for_allocation(0.20, maximum_allocation=0.80)
+            if size:
+                self.pending_add_on = True
+                self.order = self.buy(size=size)

+

+        self.sma = bt.indicators.SMA(self.data.close, period=self.p.sma_period)

+        self.atr_average_5 = bt.indicators.SMA(previous_atr, period=5)

+        self.entry_price = None
+        self.entry_atr = None
+        self.stop_price = None
+        self.trailing_active = False
+        self.pending_entry_atr = None
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        if order.status == order.Completed:
+            if order.isbuy() and self.position.size > 0:
+                self.entry_price = order.executed.price
+                self.entry_atr = self.pending_entry_atr
+                self.stop_price = self.entry_price - 1.5 * self.entry_atr
+                self.trailing_active = False
+            elif order.issell() and self.position.size < 0:
+                self.entry_price = order.executed.price
+                self.entry_atr = self.pending_entry_atr
+                self.stop_price = self.entry_price + 1.5 * self.entry_atr
+                self.trailing_active = False
+            elif not self.position:
+                self.entry_price = None
+                self.entry_atr = None
+                self.stop_price = None
+                self.trailing_active = False
+
+        if order.status in (
+            order.Completed,
+            order.Canceled,
+            order.Margin,
+            order.Rejected,
+        ):
+            self.order = None
+            self.pending_entry_atr = None
+
+    def next(self):
+        if self.order:
+            return
+
+        if self.position:
+            current_atr = float(self.atr[0])
+
+            if self.position.size > 0:
+                if not self.trailing_active and self.data.high[0] >= self.entry_price + self.entry_atr:
+                    self.trailing_active = True
+                if self.trailing_active:
+                    self.stop_price = max(
+                        self.stop_price,
+                        float(self.data.high[0]) - current_atr,
+                    )
+                if self.data.low[0] <= self.stop_price:

+            else:

+            and self.data.close[0] < self.sma[0]
+            and volatility_allowed
+            and short_gap_allowed
+        ):
+            self.pending_entry_atr = atr_value
+            self.order = self.sell(size=size)

+import backtrader as bt
+import math
+
+
+class SupplyDemandStrategy(bt.Strategy):
+    params = (("risk_fraction", 0.01),)
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.order = None
+        self.rsi = bt.indicators.RSI(self.data.close, period=14)
+        self._four_hour_bars = []
+        self._daily_bars = []
+        self._current_four_hour = None
+        self._current_day = None
+        self._demand_zones = []
+        self._supply_zones = []
+        self._daily_trend = None
+        self._entry_stop = None
+        self._entry_target = None
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _new_bar(key, open_price, high, low, close, volume):
+        return {
+            "key": key,
+            "open": open_price,
+            "high": high,
+            "low": low,
+            "close": close,
+            "volume": volume,
+        }
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _update_bar(bar, high, low, close, volume):
+        bar["high"] = max(bar["high"], high)
+        bar["low"] = min(bar["low"], low)
+        bar["close"] = close
+        bar["volume"] += volume
+
+    def _identify_zone(self, bars, timeframe):
+        if len(bars) < 4:
+            return
+
+        consolidation = bars[-4:-1]
+        impulse = bars[-1]
+        lower = min(bar["low"] for bar in consolidation)
+        upper = max(bar["high"] for bar in consolidation)
+        height = upper - lower
+        if height < 0.005 * impulse["close"]:
+            return
+
+        impulse_body = abs(impulse["close"] - impulse["open"])
+        if impulse["close"] > upper and impulse["close"] > impulse["open"] and impulse_body >= height:
+            self._demand_zones.append((lower, upper, timeframe))
+        elif impulse["close"] < lower and impulse["close"] < impulse["open"] and impulse_body >= height:
+            self._supply_zones.append((lower, upper, timeframe))
+
+    def _finish_four_hour_bar(self):
+        self._four_hour_bars.append(self._current_four_hour)
+        self._identify_zone(self._four_hour_bars, "4H")
+
+    def _finish_daily_bar(self):
+        self._daily_bars.append(self._current_day)
+        self._identify_zone(self._daily_bars, "1D")
+        if len(self._daily_bars) >= 2:
+            latest = self._daily_bars[-1]["close"]
+            previous = self._daily_bars[-2]["close"]
+            self._daily_trend = "up" if latest > previous else "down" if latest < previous else None
+
+    def _aggregate(self):
+        timestamp = self.data.datetime.datetime(0)
+        open_price = float(self.data.open[0])
+        high = float(self.data.high[0])
+        low = float(self.data.low[0])
+        close = float(self.data.close[0])
+        volume = float(self.data.volume[0])
+
+        four_hour_key = (timestamp.date(), timestamp.hour // 4)
+        if self._current_four_hour is None:
+            self._current_four_hour = self._new_bar(four_hour_key, open_price, high, low, close, volume)
+        elif self._current_four_hour["key"] != four_hour_key:
+            self._finish_four_hour_bar()
+            self._current_four_hour = self._new_bar(four_hour_key, open_price, high, low, close, volume)
+        else:
+            self._update_bar(self._current_four_hour, high, low, close, volume)
+
+        day_key = timestamp.date()
+        if self._current_day is None:
+            self._current_day = self._new_bar(day_key, open_price, high, low, close, volume)
+        elif self._current_day["key"] != day_key:
+            self._finish_daily_bar()
+            self._current_day = self._new_bar(day_key, open_price, high, low, close, volume)
+        else:
+            self._update_bar(self._current_day, high, low, close, volume)
+
+    def _long_setup(self):
+        low = float(self.data.low[0])
+        close = float(self.data.close[0])
+        candidates = [
+            zone for zone in self._demand_zones
+            if low <= zone[1] and close >= zone[0] and close >= (zone[0] + zone[1]) / 2.0
+        ]
+        return max(candidates, key=lambda zone: zone[0]) if candidates else None
+
+    def _short_setup(self):
+        high = float(self.data.high[0])
+        close = float(self.data.close[0])
+        candidates = [
+            zone for zone in self._supply_zones
+            if high >= zone[0] and close <= zone[1] and close <= (zone[0] + zone[1]) / 2.0
+        ]
+        return min(candidates, key=lambda zone: zone[1]) if candidates else None
+
+    def _position_size(self, entry, stop):
+        risk_per_unit = abs(entry - stop)
+        if risk_per_unit == 0:
+            return 0
+        return math.floor((self.broker.getvalue() * self.p.risk_fraction) / risk_per_unit)
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        if order.status in (order.Completed, order.Canceled, order.Margin, order.Rejected):
+            self.order = None
+            if order.status != order.Completed and not self.position:
+                self._entry_stop = None
+                self._entry_target = None
+
+    def next(self):
+        self._aggregate()
+
+        if self.order:
+            return
+
+        close = float(self.data.close[0])
+        if self.position:
+            if self.position.size > 0 and (close <= self._entry_stop or close >= self._entry_target):
+                self.order = self.close()
+            elif self.position.size < 0 and (close >= self._entry_stop or close <= self._entry_target):
+                self.order = self.close()
+            return
+
+        if self._daily_trend == "up" and self.rsi[0] < 50:
+            zone = self._long_setup()
+            if zone is not None:
+                stop = zone[0] * 0.995
+                higher_supply = [supply[0] for supply in self._supply_zones if supply[0] > close]
+                target = min(higher_supply) if higher_supply else close + 2.0 * (close - stop)
+                size = self._position_size(close, stop)
+                if size > 0:
+                    self._entry_stop = stop
+                    self._entry_target = target
+                    self.order = self.buy(size=size)
+                return
+
+        if self._daily_trend == "down" and self.rsi[0] > 50:
+            zone = self._short_setup()
+            if zone is not None:
+                stop = zone[1] * 1.005
+                lower_demand = [demand[1] for demand in self._demand_zones if demand[1] < close]
+                target = max(lower_demand) if lower_demand else close - 2.0 * (stop - close)
+                size = self._position_size(close, stop)
+                if size > 0:
+                    self._entry_stop = stop
+                    self._entry_target = target
+                    self.order = self.sell(size=size)

+        self.sma20 = bt.indicators.SimpleMovingAverage(self.data.close, period=20)
+        self.atr14 = bt.indicators.AverageTrueRange(self.data, period=14)
+        self.crossover = bt.indicators.CrossOver(self.sma10, self.sma20)
+        self.order = None
+

+        if order.status in (
+            order.Completed,
+            order.Canceled,
+            order.Margin,
+            order.Rejected,
+        ):
+            self.order = None
+
+    def next(self):
+        if self.order:
+            return
+
+        bar_time = self.data.datetime.datetime(0)
+        minute = bar_time.hour * 60 + bar_time.minute
+
+        # A market order submitted on the 15:50 bar executes on the 15:55 bar,
+        # five minutes before the regular-session close.
+        if self.position and minute >= 15 * 60 + 50:
+            self.order = self.close()
+            return
+
+        if self.position:
+            entry = self.position.price
+            if self.position.size > 0:
+                if self.crossover[0] < 0 or self.data.close[0] <= entry * 0.99:

+            else:
+                if self.crossover[0] > 0 or self.data.close[0] >= entry * 1.01:
+                    self.order = self.close()
+            return
+
+        regular_session = 9 * 60 + 30 <= minute < 16 * 60
+        after_open_buffer = minute >= 9 * 60 + 35
+        outside_close_buffer = minute <= 15 * 60 + 30
+        if not (regular_session and after_open_buffer and outside_close_buffer):
+            return

+        near_sma20 = abs(close - self.sma20[0]) <= 0.5 * self.atr14[0]
+        if not near_sma20:
+            return
+
+        quantity = math.floor(
+            self.broker.getvalue() * 0.01 / (close * 0.01)
+        )
+        if quantity <= 0:
+            return
+
+        if self.crossover[0] > 0:
+            self.order = self.buy(size=quantity)
+        elif self.crossover[0] < 0:
+            self.order = self.sell(size=quantity)

+import backtrader as bt
+
+
+class MultiTimeframeCandlestickAggregationStrategy(bt.Strategy):
+    """Aggregate engulfing patterns in nested, feed-aligned time windows."""
+
+    params = (
+        ("timeframes", (120, 60, 30, 15)),
+        ("risk_per_trade", 0.01),
+        ("atr_period", 14),
+        ("stop_atr", 0.5),
+        ("target_atr", 1.5),
+    )
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.order = None
+        self.atr = bt.indicators.ATR(self.data, period=self.p.atr_period)
+        self._base_minutes = self.p.timeframes[-1]
+        self._bars_per_window = self.p.timeframes[0] // self._base_minutes
+        self._window = []
+        self._window_start_previous = None
+        self._previous = {minutes: None for minutes in self.p.timeframes}
+        self.pattern_counts = {minutes: 0 for minutes in self.p.timeframes}
+        self.pattern_count_history = []
+        self.entry_price = None
+        self.entry_atr = None
+        self._entry_atr_for_order = None
+
+    def bullish_pattern(self, previous, current):
+        """The replaceable selected pattern: bullish engulfing."""
+        return (
+            previous is not None
+            and previous[3] < previous[0]
+            and current[3] > current[0]
+            and current[0] <= previous[3]
+            and current[3] >= previous[0]
+        )
+
+    def bearish_pattern(self, previous, current):
+        """Opposite of the selected pattern: bearish engulfing."""
+        return (
+            previous is not None
+            and previous[3] > previous[0]
+            and current[3] < current[0]
+            and current[0] >= previous[3]
+            and current[3] <= previous[0]
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _aggregate(bars):
+        return (
+            bars[0][0],
+            max(bar[1] for bar in bars),
+            min(bar[2] for bar in bars),
+            bars[-1][3],
+        )
+
+    def _complete_window(self):
+        candles = {}
+        occurrences = {}
+
+        for minutes in self.p.timeframes:
+            group_size = minutes // self._base_minutes
+            timeframe_candles = [
+                self._aggregate(self._window[start:start + group_size])
+                for start in range(0, len(self._window), group_size)
+            ]
+            candles[minutes] = timeframe_candles
+
+            previous = (
+                self._window_start_previous
+                if minutes == self._base_minutes
+                else self._previous[minutes]
+            )
+            flags = []
+            for candle in timeframe_candles:
+                flags.append(self.bullish_pattern(previous, candle))
+                previous = candle
+            occurrences[minutes] = flags
+            self._previous[minutes] = timeframe_candles[-1]
+
+        highest = self.p.timeframes[0]
+        if not occurrences[highest][-1]:
+            return False
+
+        counts = {
+            minutes: sum(occurrences[minutes])
+            for minutes in self.p.timeframes
+        }
+        self.pattern_counts = counts
+        self.pattern_count_history.append(dict(counts))
+
+        return all(
+            counts[lower] > counts[higher]
+            for higher, lower in zip(self.p.timeframes, self.p.timeframes[1:])
+        )
+
+    def next(self):
+        bar = (
+            float(self.data.open[0]),
+            float(self.data.high[0]),
+            float(self.data.low[0]),
+            float(self.data.close[0]),
+        )
+        previous_base = self._previous[self._base_minutes]
+        opposite_signal = self.bearish_pattern(previous_base, bar)
+        if not self._window:
+            self._window_start_previous = previous_base
+        self._window.append(bar)
+
+        entry_signal = False
+        if len(self._window) == self._bars_per_window:
+            entry_signal = self._complete_window()
+            self._window = []
+
+        # The completed base candle must become the predecessor only after both
+        # entry-window counting and the opposite-pattern test have used it.
+        self._previous[self._base_minutes] = bar
+
+        if self.order:
+            return
+
+        if self.position:
+            stop_price = self.entry_price - self.p.stop_atr * self.entry_atr
+            target_price = self.entry_price + self.p.target_atr * self.entry_atr
+            if opposite_signal or self.data.low[0] <= stop_price or self.data.high[0] >= target_price:
+                self.order = self.close()
+            return
+
+        if entry_signal:
+            atr = float(self.atr[0])
+            stop_distance = self.p.stop_atr * atr
+            if stop_distance > 0:
+                risk_capital = self.broker.getvalue() * self.p.risk_per_trade
+                self._entry_atr_for_order = atr
+                self.order = self.buy(size=risk_capital / stop_distance)
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        if order.status == order.Completed:
+            if order.isbuy():
+                self.entry_price = order.executed.price
+                self.entry_atr = self._entry_atr_for_order
+            else:
+                self.entry_price = None
+                self.entry_atr = None
+                self._entry_atr_for_order = None
+
+        if order.status in (
+            order.Completed,
+            order.Canceled,
+            order.Margin,
+            order.Rejected,
+        ):
+            if order.status != order.Completed or not order.isbuy():
+                self._entry_atr_for_order = None
+            self.order = None

+import backtrader as bt
+
+
+class PyramidingInTrend(bt.Strategy):
+    """EMA/RSI trend strategy with up to three pyramid additions."""
+
+    params = (
+        ("ema_period", 50),
+        ("rsi_period", 14),
+        ("capital_fraction", 0.01),
+        ("maximum_entries", 4),
+    )
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.ema = bt.indicators.ExponentialMovingAverage(
+            self.data.close, period=self.p.ema_period
+        )
+        self.rsi = bt.indicators.RelativeStrengthIndex(
+            self.data.close, period=self.p.rsi_period
+        )
+
+        self.order = None
+        self.initial_cash = None
+        self.entry_size = None
+        self.entry_count = 0
+
+        self.rsi_was_below_50 = False
+        self.rsi_reached_70 = False
+        self.rsi_was_above_60 = False
+        self.break_even_exit_done = False
+        self.take_profit_exit_done = False
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.initial_cash = self.broker.getcash()
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        if order.status not in (
+            order.Completed,
+            order.Canceled,
+            order.Margin,
+            order.Rejected,
+        ):
+            return
+
+        if order.status == order.Completed and order.isbuy():
+            self.entry_count += 1
+
+        self.order = None
+
+        if not self.position:
+            self.entry_size = None
+            self.entry_count = 0
+            self.rsi_reached_70 = False
+            self.rsi_was_above_60 = False
+            self.break_even_exit_done = False
+            self.take_profit_exit_done = False
+
+    def next(self):
+        close = self.data.close[0]
+        rsi = self.rsi[0]
+
+        if rsi < 50:
+            self.rsi_was_below_50 = True
+
+        if self.order:
+            return
+
+        if self.position:
+            if rsi > 60:
+                self.rsi_was_above_60 = True
+            if rsi >= 70:
+                self.rsi_reached_70 = True
+
+            # Full exits take precedence over profit-management reductions.
+            if close < self.ema[0]:
+                self.order = self.close()
+                return
+            if self.rsi_was_above_60 and rsi < 40:
+                self.order = self.close()
+                return
+
+            position_return = (close - self.position.price) / self.position.price
+            if not self.break_even_exit_done and position_return >= 0:
+                self.break_even_exit_done = True
+                self.order = self.close(size=self.position.size * 0.25)
+                return
+            if (
+                self.break_even_exit_done
+                and not self.take_profit_exit_done
+                and position_return >= 0.05
+            ):
+                self.take_profit_exit_done = True
+                self.order = self.close(size=self.position.size * 0.50)
+                return
+
+            if (
+                close > self.ema[0]
+                and self.entry_count < self.p.maximum_entries
+                and self.rsi_reached_70
+                and rsi <= 60
+            ):
+                self.rsi_reached_70 = False
+                self.order = self.buy(size=self.entry_size)
+            return
+
+        if close > self.ema[0] and self.rsi_was_below_50 and rsi > 50:
+            self.rsi_was_below_50 = False
+            self.entry_size = (
+                self.initial_cash * self.p.capital_fraction / close
+            )
+            self.order = self.buy(size=self.entry_size)

+import backtrader as bt
+
+
+class RetestBrokenResistanceStrategy(bt.Strategy):
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.sma50 = bt.indicators.SMA(self.data.close, period=50)
+        self.atr14 = bt.indicators.ATR(self.data, period=14)
+
+        self.order = None
+        self.stop_order = None
+        self.tp_orders = []
+        self.pivot_highs = []
+        self.pivot_lows = []
+        self.broken_levels = set()
+        self.breakout = None
+        self.pending_entry = None
+        self.entry_order_bar = None
+        self.entry_price = None
+        self.stop_price = None
+        self.remaining_size = 0.0
+
+    def next(self):
+        if self.order is not None and len(self) > self.entry_order_bar:
+            self.cancel(self.order)
+            return
+
+        # A three-bar pivot becomes knowable on the bar after its centre.
+        if len(self) >= 3:
+            if self.data.high[-1] > self.data.high[-2] and self.data.high[-1] > self.data.high[0]:
+                self.pivot_highs.append((len(self) - 1, float(self.data.high[-1])))
+            if self.data.low[-1] < self.data.low[-2] and self.data.low[-1] < self.data.low[0]:
+                self.pivot_lows.append((len(self) - 1, float(self.data.low[-1])))
+
+        if self.position:
+            return
+        if self.order is not None:
+            return
+
+        close = float(self.data.close[0])
+        atr = float(self.atr14[0])
+
+        # A newer confirmed breakout supersedes an older level awaiting retest.
+        for _, level in reversed(self.pivot_highs):
+            key = (level,)
+            if key not in self.broken_levels and close >= level + 0.25 * atr:
+                self.broken_levels.add(key)
+                self.breakout = {
+                    'level': level,
+                    'breakout_bar': len(self),
+                    'signal_seen': False,
+                }
+                break
+
+        if self.breakout is None:
+            return
+
+        days_after = len(self) - self.breakout['breakout_bar']
+        if days_after > 10:
+            self.breakout = None
+            return
+        if days_after < 1 or self.breakout['signal_seen']:
+            return
+
+        level = self.breakout['level']
+        open_ = float(self.data.open[0])
+        high = float(self.data.high[0])
+        low = float(self.data.low[0])
+        previous_high = float(self.data.high[-1])
+        previous_close = float(self.data.close[-1])
+
+        touches_level = abs(low - level) <= 0.25 * atr
+        body = abs(close - open_)
+        lower_wick = min(open_, close) - low
+        hammer = lower_wick >= 1.5 * body and close > open_
+        bullish_engulfing = close > previous_high and open_ <= previous_close
+        long_lower_wick_at_level = low <= level and close > open_
+        bullish_signal = hammer or bullish_engulfing or long_lower_wick_at_level
+
+        rising_pivot_lows = (
+            len(self.pivot_lows) >= 2
+            and self.pivot_lows[-1][1] > self.pivot_lows[-2][1]
+        )
+        uptrend = close > self.sma50[0] and self.sma50[0] > self.sma50[-5]
+        volatility_ok = atr / close <= 0.025 and (high - low) / close <= 0.035
+
+        if touches_level and bullish_signal and uptrend and rising_pivot_lows and volatility_ok:
+            self.breakout['signal_seen'] = True
+            stop_price = level - 0.5 * atr
+            maximum_allowed_open = level + 0.5 * atr
+            maximum_risk_per_unit = maximum_allowed_open - stop_price
+            quantity = (self.broker.getvalue() * 0.01) / maximum_risk_per_unit
+            self.pending_entry = {
+                'level': level,
+                'atr': atr,
+                'stop': stop_price,
+                'size': quantity,
+            }
+            self.entry_order_bar = len(self)
+            # A buy limit gives a next-bar open fill when that open is at or
+            # below the permitted maximum; the fill is then the entry price.
+            self.order = self.buy(
+                size=quantity,
+                exectype=bt.Order.Limit,
+                price=maximum_allowed_open,
+            )
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        if order.status in (order.Submitted, order.Accepted, order.Partial):
+            return
+
+        if order is self.order:
+            self.order = None
+            self.entry_order_bar = None
+            if order.status == order.Completed:
+                self.entry_price = float(order.executed.price)
+                self.stop_price = self.pending_entry['stop']
+                self.remaining_size = abs(float(order.executed.size))
+                risk = self.entry_price - self.stop_price
+                quarter = self.remaining_size * 0.25
+                self.stop_order = self.sell(
+                    size=self.remaining_size,
+                    exectype=bt.Order.Stop,
+                    price=self.stop_price,
+                )
+                self.tp_orders = [
+                    self.sell(
+                        size=quarter,
+                        exectype=bt.Order.Limit,
+                        price=self.entry_price + multiple * risk,
+                    )
+                    for multiple in (2.0, 4.0, 6.0, 8.0)
+                ]
+            else:
+                self.pending_entry = None
+                self.breakout = None
+            return
+
+        if order is self.stop_order:
+            if order.status == order.Completed:
+                for take_profit in self.tp_orders:
+                    if take_profit.alive():
+                        self.cancel(take_profit)
+                self.tp_orders = []
+                self.stop_order = None
+                self.remaining_size = 0.0
+                self.pending_entry = None
+                self.breakout = None
+            elif order.status in (order.Margin, order.Rejected):
+                self.stop_order = None
+            return
+
+        if order in self.tp_orders and order.status == order.Completed:
+            self.remaining_size = max(0.0, self.remaining_size - abs(float(order.executed.size)))
+            if self.remaining_size == 0.0:
+                if self.stop_order is not None and self.stop_order.alive():
+                    self.cancel(self.stop_order)
+                self.stop_order = None
+                self.pending_entry = None
+                self.breakout = None
+            elif self.stop_order is not None and self.stop_order.alive():
+                # Keep one common fixed-price stop sized to the shares left.
+                old_stop = self.stop_order
+                self.stop_order = None
+                self.cancel(old_stop)
+                self.stop_order = self.sell(
+                    size=self.remaining_size,
+                    exectype=bt.Order.Stop,
+                    price=self.stop_price,
+                )

+import backtrader as bt
+
+
+class PullbackFibonacciEMAStrategy(bt.Strategy):
+    params = (("ema_period", 20), ("risk_fraction", 0.01))
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.ema = bt.indicators.EMA(self.data.close, period=self.p.ema_period)
+        self.entry_order = None
+        self.exit_orders = []
+        self.planned_stop = None
+        self.planned_targets = None
+        self.pullback_seen = False
+        self.entry_price = None
+        self.second_size = 0
+        self.second_stop = None
+        self.second_limit = None
+        self.first_target = None
+
+    def _cancel_exits(self, except_order=None):
+        for order in list(self.exit_orders):
+            if order is not except_order and order.alive():
+                self.cancel(order)
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        terminal = (order.Completed, order.Canceled, order.Margin, order.Rejected)
+        if order is self.entry_order and order.status in terminal:
+            if order.status == order.Completed:
+                self.entry_price = order.executed.price
+                risk = self.entry_price - self.planned_stop
+                if risk <= 0:
+                    self.close()
+                else:
+                    minimum_target = self.entry_price + 9.0 * risk
+                    target_one = max(self.planned_targets[0], minimum_target)
+                    target_two = max(self.planned_targets[1], target_one, minimum_target)
+                    total = abs(order.executed.size)
+                    first_size = total // 2
+                    self.second_size = total - first_size
+                    if first_size:
+                        stop_one = self.sell(size=first_size, exectype=bt.Order.Stop,
+                                             price=self.planned_stop)
+                        limit_one = self.sell(size=first_size, exectype=bt.Order.Limit,
+                                              price=target_one, oco=stop_one)
+                        self.exit_orders.extend((stop_one, limit_one))
+                        self.first_target = limit_one
+                    if self.second_size:
+                        self.second_stop = self.sell(size=self.second_size,
+                                                     exectype=bt.Order.Stop,
+                                                     price=self.planned_stop)
+                        self.second_limit = self.sell(size=self.second_size,
+                                                     exectype=bt.Order.Limit,
+                                                     price=target_two,
+                                                     oco=self.second_stop)
+                        self.exit_orders.extend((self.second_stop, self.second_limit))
+            self.entry_order = None
+            return
+
+        if order not in self.exit_orders or order.status not in terminal:
+            return
+
+        if order.status == order.Completed:
+            if order is self.first_target and self.position and self.second_stop is not None:
+                second_target_price = self.second_limit.created.price
+                if self.second_stop.alive():
+                    self.cancel(self.second_stop)
+                breakeven = self.sell(size=abs(self.position.size),
+                                      exectype=bt.Order.Stop,
+                                      price=self.entry_price)
+                replacement_target = self.sell(size=abs(self.position.size),
+                                               exectype=bt.Order.Limit,
+                                               price=second_target_price,
+                                               oco=breakeven)
+                self.exit_orders.extend((breakeven, replacement_target))
+                self.second_stop = breakeven
+                self.second_limit = replacement_target
+            elif not self.position:
+                self._cancel_exits(except_order=order)
+
+        if not self.position and self.entry_order is None:
+            if not any(candidate.alive() for candidate in self.exit_orders):
+                self.exit_orders = []
+                self.planned_stop = None
+                self.planned_targets = None
+                self.pullback_seen = False
+                self.entry_price = None
+                self.second_size = 0
+                self.second_stop = None
+                self.second_limit = None
+                self.first_target = None
+
+    def next(self):
+        if self.entry_order is not None or self.position or any(
+                order.alive() for order in self.exit_orders):
+            return
+
+        close = float(self.data.close[0])
+        previous_close = float(self.data.close[-1])
+        if close <= float(self.ema[0]):
+            self.pullback_seen = False
+            return
+
+        if previous_close < float(self.data.close[-2]):
+            self.pullback_seen = True
+
+        if not self.pullback_seen:
+            return
+
+        significant_low = min(float(self.data.low[-i]) for i in range(1, 21))
+        previous_high = max(float(self.data.high[-i]) for i in range(1, 21))
+        price_range = previous_high - significant_low
+        if price_range <= 0:
+            return
+
+        ratios = (0.236, 0.382, 0.500, 0.618)
+        levels = [previous_high - price_range * ratio for ratio in ratios]
+        touched = [level for level in levels
+                   if float(self.data.low[0]) <= level <= float(self.data.high[0])]
+        bullish_reversal = close > float(self.data.open[0]) and close > previous_close
+        if not touched or not bullish_reversal:
+            return
+
+        entry_level = min(touched, key=lambda level: abs(close - level))
+        nearest_low = min(float(self.data.low[-1]), float(self.data.low[0]))
+        stop_price = min(nearest_low, entry_level) * 0.999
+        risk_per_share = close - stop_price
+        if risk_per_share <= 0:
+            return
+
+        risk_cash = float(self.broker.getvalue()) * self.p.risk_fraction
+        risk_size = int(risk_cash / risk_per_share)
+        affordable_size = int(float(self.broker.getcash()) /
+                              (close * (1.0 + 0.001)))
+        size = min(risk_size, affordable_size)
+        if size < 1:
+            return
+
+        higher_levels = sorted(level for level in levels if level > close)
+        target_one = higher_levels[0] if higher_levels else previous_high
+        target_two = higher_levels[1] if len(higher_levels) > 1 else previous_high
+        self.planned_stop = stop_price
+        self.planned_targets = (target_one, target_two)
+        self.entry_order = self.buy(size=size)

+import backtrader as bt
+import math
+
+
+class TrendChannelBreakoutStrategy(bt.Strategy):
+    """Intraday morning-channel breakout reference implementation."""
+
+    params = (
+        ("rsi_period", 14),
+        ("tsi_first_smoothing", 25),
+        ("tsi_second_smoothing", 13),
+        ("sma_fast_period", 20),
+        ("sma_slow_period", 50),
+        ("risk_fraction", 0.01),
+        ("stop_fraction", 0.005),
+        ("volatile_channel_fraction", 0.01),
+        ("low_volume_fraction", 0.50),
+    )
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.rsi = bt.indicators.RSI(self.data.close, period=self.p.rsi_period)
+        self.sma20 = bt.indicators.SMA(
+            self.data.close, period=self.p.sma_fast_period
+        )
+        self.sma50 = bt.indicators.SMA(
+            self.data.close, period=self.p.sma_slow_period
+        )
+
+        change = self.data.close - self.data.close(-1)
+        smoothed_change = bt.indicators.EMA(
+            bt.indicators.EMA(change, period=self.p.tsi_first_smoothing),
+            period=self.p.tsi_second_smoothing,
+        )
+        smoothed_absolute_change = bt.indicators.EMA(
+            bt.indicators.EMA(abs(change), period=self.p.tsi_first_smoothing),
+            period=self.p.tsi_second_smoothing,
+        )
+        self.tsi = 100.0 * bt.DivByZero(
+            smoothed_change, smoothed_absolute_change, zero=0.0
+        )
+
+        self.order = None
+        self.entry_price = None
+        self.stop_price = None
+        self.upper_channel = None
+        self.lower_channel = None
+        self.channel_too_volatile = False
+        self.session_date = None
+
+        self.pvt = 0.0
+        self.vwap = float("nan")
+        self._daily_price_volume = 0.0
+        self._daily_volume = 0.0
+        self._previous_close = None
+
+        self._five_minute_key = None
+        self._five_minute_close = None
+        self._five_minute_volume = 0.0
+        self._five_minute_sma20 = None
+        self._five_minute_sma50 = None
+        self._five_minute_rsi = None
+        self._five_minute_tsi = None
+        self._volume_history = {}
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        if order.status == order.Completed:
+            if order.isbuy():
+                self.entry_price = order.executed.price
+                percentage_stop = self.entry_price * (1.0 - self.p.stop_fraction)
+                self.stop_price = min(
+                    percentage_stop,
+                    self.lower_channel - 1.0e-9,
+                )
+            else:
+                self.entry_price = None
+                self.stop_price = None
+            self.order = None
+        elif order.status in (order.Canceled, order.Margin, order.Rejected):
+            self.order = None
+
+    def _start_session(self, session_date):
+        self.session_date = session_date
+        self.upper_channel = None
+        self.lower_channel = None
+        self.channel_too_volatile = False
+        self._daily_price_volume = 0.0
+        self._daily_volume = 0.0
+        self.vwap = float("nan")
+        self._five_minute_key = None
+        self._five_minute_close = None
+        self._five_minute_volume = 0.0
+
+        # Indicator minperiods can make the first ``next`` occur after the two
+        # channel candles, so recover those already-delivered bars verbatim.
+        for ago in range(0, -len(self.data), -1):
+            bar_time = self.data.datetime.datetime(ago)
+            if bar_time.date() != session_date:
+                break
+            minute = bar_time.hour * 60 + bar_time.minute
+            if minute == 9 * 60 + 55:
+                self.upper_channel = float(self.data.high[ago])
+            elif minute == 10 * 60:
+                self.lower_channel = float(self.data.low[ago])
+        if self.upper_channel is not None and self.lower_channel is not None:
+            self.channel_too_volatile = (
+                self.upper_channel - self.lower_channel
+                > self.p.volatile_channel_fraction * self.upper_channel
+            )
+
+    def _finish_five_minute_bar(self, key, close, volume):
+        history = self._volume_history.setdefault(key, [])
+        average_volume = sum(history) / len(history) if history else None
+        volume_is_adequate = (
+            average_volume is None
+            or volume >= self.p.low_volume_fraction * average_volume
+        )
+
+        if self.position:
+            # A close below the upper boundary is back inside the original channel;
+            # on the first bar after entry this is also the immediate-whipsaw rule.
+            if (
+                self.order is None
+                and self.upper_channel is not None
+                and self.lower_channel is not None
+                and self.lower_channel <= close <= self.upper_channel
+            ):
+                self.order = self.close()
+        elif (
+            self.order is None
+            and self.upper_channel is not None
+            and self.lower_channel is not None
+            and not self.channel_too_volatile
+            and key[1] < 15 * 60
+            and close > self.upper_channel
+            and self._five_minute_sma20 > self._five_minute_sma50
+            and self._five_minute_rsi > 50.0
+            and self._five_minute_tsi > 0.0
+            and volume_is_adequate
+        ):
+            proposed_stop = min(
+                close * (1.0 - self.p.stop_fraction),
+                self.lower_channel - 1.0e-9,
+            )
+            risk_per_share = close - proposed_stop
+            risk_budget = self.broker.getvalue() * self.p.risk_fraction
+            risk_size = math.floor(risk_budget / risk_per_share)
+            affordable_size = math.floor(
+                self.broker.getcash() / (close * (1.0 + 0.001))
+            )
+            size = min(risk_size, affordable_size)
+            if size > 0:
+                self.order = self.buy(size=size)
+
+        history.append(volume)
+
+    def next(self):
+        timestamp = self.data.datetime.datetime(0)
+        if timestamp.date() != self.session_date:
+            self._start_session(timestamp.date())
+
+        close = float(self.data.close[0])
+        volume = float(self.data.volume[0])
+        typical_price = (
+            float(self.data.high[0]) + float(self.data.low[0]) + close
+        ) / 3.0
+        self._daily_price_volume += typical_price * volume
+        self._daily_volume += volume
+        if self._daily_volume:
+            self.vwap = self._daily_price_volume / self._daily_volume
+
+        if self._previous_close not in (None, 0.0):
+            self.pvt += volume * (close - self._previous_close) / self._previous_close
+        self._previous_close = close
+
+        minute = timestamp.hour * 60 + timestamp.minute
+        if minute == 9 * 60 + 55:
+            self.upper_channel = float(self.data.high[0])
+        elif minute == 10 * 60:
+            self.lower_channel = float(self.data.low[0])
+            if self.upper_channel is not None:
+                channel_range = self.upper_channel - self.lower_channel
+                self.channel_too_volatile = (
+                    channel_range > self.p.volatile_channel_fraction * self.upper_channel

+class WeeklyORB(bt.Strategy):

+

+        self._week = None
+        self._week_high = None
+        self._week_low = None
+        self._week_midpoint = None
+        self._week_day = 0
+        self._breakout_day = None
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        if order.status in (
+            order.Completed,
+            order.Canceled,
+            order.Margin,
+            order.Rejected,
+        ):
+            if order is self.order:
+                self.order = None
+            if order in self._bracket and order.status in (
+                order.Canceled,
+                order.Margin,
+                order.Rejected,
+            ):
+                self._bracket.remove(order)
+
+    def next(self):
+        current_date = self.data.datetime.date(0)
+        iso = current_date.isocalendar()
+        current_week = (iso[0], iso[1])
+
+        if current_week != self._week:
+            self._week = current_week
+            self._week_high = float(self.data.high[0])
+            self._week_low = float(self.data.low[0])
+            self._week_midpoint = (self._week_high + self._week_low) / 2.0
+            self._week_day = 0
+            self._breakout_day = None
+        else:
+            self._week_day += 1

+        if days_after_breakout < 1:
+            return
+        if days_after_breakout > 2:
+            return
+
+        close = float(self.data.close[0])
+        returned_and_crossed_down = (
+            float(self.data.high[0]) >= self._week_midpoint
+            and close <= self._week_midpoint
+        )
+        trend_filter = (

+            and float(self.ema20[0]) < float(self.sma50[0])

+

+
+        self.order = None

+

+            self.order = None
+        if self.stop_order is not None and order.ref == self.stop_order.ref:
+            self.stop_order = None
+
